text: WRFrontiersDB-Design deployment/propagation: design repo has no deploy of its own; consumers pin it via submodule SHA. A design change reaches the live sites only via a 3-step chain: (1) merge in WRFrontiersDB-Design, (2) bump the submodule pointer in EACH consumer (commit new gitlink) via PR, (3) redeploy consumer. Site auto-deploys on push to main (PR base is dev, so promote dev->main); visualizer deploys ONLY via manual workflow_dispatch. Fold this into the Phase 3 style docs + the design repo README. Ref: WRFrontiersDB-Site/personal/style-rework-plan.md section 7.
